title: Negative lines parameter inverts capture direction
description: Line 235: `pane.capture_pane(start=-lines)`. If `lines=-10`, then `start=10`, capturing from line 10 forward instead of the last N lines. The API accepts any int with no validation. Trigger: `GET /panes/%1/output?lines=-100`. Should reject negative values with 400 or clamp to 0.
